title: Use Seedance 2.5 with Flova’s Scripted Short Film workflow to generate a short…
content:
Use Seedance 2.5 with Flova’s Scripted Short Film workflow to generate a short film from a script.  
Add a Voice Reference in Seedance 2.5 to match the narration/voice style to a provided reference.
